\C[14]Ah, please don't walk too far, or you may
get lost in this map
\C[14]As you see, this is a ventilation map, it
originally appeared after Yuu shrunk and climbed into
the ventilation duct from the changing room.
\C[14]The reason I deleted this map was very simple...
As you can see, it's too complex, lots of players
wouldn't have been able to find the exit.
\C[14]I was afraid that players would get annoyed, so I
replace it with an easier version.
\C[14]In addition, I thought about placing some chests
in this map, so that players won't get bored.
\C[14]If you're interested, you can open those chests,
there'll be some coins inside.
